statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 19%; Stress 100%.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH while the weekend closure prevents live path confirmation; fresh Hormuz and Saudi export-route disruptions keep Stress extreme.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress after fresh Hormuz shipping attack
body: NQ remains weekend-closed until the scheduled 22:00 UTC Sunday reopen. A newly reported vessel strike in the Strait of Hormuz compounds the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and Bab el-Mandeb risk. These raise gap and volatility risk, but no live NQ path exists to confirm persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock hours, Tail stayed at 19% while Stress rose from 96% to 99%; NQ remained weekend-closed, so no new live price-path evidence was available.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through most of the closure, enters WATCH three hours before reopening, reaches 24% around the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen and first post-open hour, then eases only if meaningful retracements and two-way trade emerge.

If the geopolitical picture is unchanged, the assessment remains high-volatility but not yet pathological; future one-way structure would need confirmation after Globex resumes.
As the reopen approaches, an unchanged news backdrop still leaves the eventual gap direction uncertain. Tail remains below WATCH until the risk window becomes more immediate.
Conditional gap risk persists into the afternoon. A de-escalation headline would narrow the distribution, while another verified attack would raise the probability of a disorderly reopen.

forecast.analysis: In the second post-open hour, the forecast assumes some price discovery is available but does not pre-assert its direction. Continued extension without retracement would keep Tail near the WATCH ceiling.
By the third post-open hour, Tail is forecast to ease modestly if liquidity normalizes and retracements appear; persistent extremes or failed pullbacks would invalidate that easing.

By the fourth post-open hour, low Tail is conditional on meaningful two-way price action and cross-asset stabilization. Repeated extension or new geopolitical shocks would invalidate the normalization case.
